snippet.title: HorrorVale - Console Announcement
snippet.description:
HorrorVale: A grand Spooktacular adventure about a girl, her dog, and her long journey to save him in a strange and horrifying Underworld!
Now, brought back to Unlife via a partnership with Electric Airship, the gates of HorrorVale once again open with enhanced visuals, exclusive battles, better performance, and more!
Coming to PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox!

Join the Official Newsletter:
https://airport.electricairship.com/horrorvale/

Wishlist:
